heroHeadline: National Assembly Cancels 2026 Municipal Elections, Extends 6,320 Officials' Terms to 2029 Ahead of OAS Foreign Ministers Session
heroSubtitle: Days after the OAS voted 29-1 to summon foreign ministers over Ortega's move to end elections, the Sandinista-controlled Assembly postponed municipal elections and extended mayors', vice-mayors' and councilmembers' terms to seven years, closing off the last remaining scheduled vote before September's constitutional reform
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
